# Created Flame Blade intrinsic lifecycle original

Frozen engine 211b71134, current schema16; recording succeeded on 20 October.
`scenario.json` declares only ordinary legal SDK operations. `recording.json`
retains actual command/outcome metadata, and Amber/Blue journal bytes are copied
unchanged from the recorder's independent prefixes.

The real spell creates/equips its fire Scimitar. The recording moves and hits,
unequips, re-equips the same item UUID, moves and hits again, advances ordinary
turns until its actual lifetime removes the blade, equips a plain Longsword and
lands an actual Crit with that different item. No packet, HP, item UUID,
condition membership, public light or native expiry was manufactured.

This original can qualify the selected modular decoration/contact assignments;
it does not approve the artwork, source pose coverage or audio. It never selects
the prohibited native weapon-body replacement.
